commitResults.messageBody: Make Command an abstract base type with non-exit behavior as its default and extract ExitCommand as the first concrete polymorphic command. Update Parser to return ExitCommand for bye while using a temporary parsed-command implementation for commands that have not yet been extracted.\n\nThis establishes the command hierarchy in a small, behavior-preserving step. Later increments can migrate one related command family at a time without requiring a risky all-at-once rewrite.

commitResults.messageBody:
The Java sources contain inconsistent documentation, naming, indentation,
and import ordering that conflict with the project coding standard.

Document public APIs, normalize parameter names and continuation
indentation, remove redundant comments, and order static imports
consistently.

These changes improve readability and consistency without changing
application behavior.

Java changes need a durable, project-specific definition of the coding
standard so future agents apply the same rules consistently.

Add a discoverable skill based on the SE-EDU basic and intermediate
standard, and require agents to load it for all Java work.

Commit and branch conventions need a durable project rule so future
agents produce consistent Git history.

Add a discoverable skill based on the SE-EDU Git conventions, and
require agents to load it for commits and branch naming.

Recognize the find command and return every task whose description contains the supplied keyword while preserving task order. Validate missing keywords and display a clear message when no tasks match.

Add JavaDoc headers to public classes and methods as per SEEDU java coding standard

commitResults.messageTitle: Refresh design to look like a chatbot

commitResults.messageBody: Added GUI using JavaFX. Adapted the UI to look more like a chatbot.

When enabled, the assert feature ensures that code holds up to assumptions at various points. Assert statements guarantee that getTaskNumber converts into an index within the tasklist. Assert also ensures that adding/removing 1 task increases/reduces the list size by 1 respectively.

Storage.load()mixes high-level file handling with low-level record decoding, making the method longer and more complicated. load() now focuses on checking the storage file, reading its lines and adding each successfully parsed task. Malformed records are now converted to null so they can be skipped.

Storage previously relied on unexplained indices, counts and encoded values. Replace these magic values with named constants to document storage schema. The named constants remain private to hide implementation details. Add guard clauses to make the valid parsing path clear.

Task creation mixes type dispatch with field validation and
construction, making the switch branches difficult to scan.

Extract each task type's construction into a focused helper so the
dispatcher stays at a consistent abstraction level and malformed records
remain easy to reject.

Ui directs messages to its configured output, but the welcome banner
bypasses that abstraction and writes to the global console. This can
split one response across different destinations.

Send the banner through the configured stream so all UI output follows
one predictable path.

Event and deadline parsing relies on numeric offsets that duplicate the
lengths of their separators. A separator change can therefore break
field extraction without an obvious connection.

Name the separators and derive each offset from its separator so the
parsing rules remain explicit and synchronized.

Parser exposes a public constructor even though it contains only static
behavior. Creating instances suggests they hold state or provide
instance-level operations.

Make the class constructor private so its utility-only role is explicit
and accidental instantiation is prevented.

Task details are exposed to subclasses as mutable fields even though
their values should remain stable after construction. This broad access
makes task invariants harder to protect.

Keep task state private and make immutable values final. Reuse the base
storage representation so subclasses can extend it without accessing
internal fields directly.

Todo overrides toString without changing its inherited behavior. The
override adds code to maintain and suggests a specialization that does
not exist.

Remove the dead override so Todo inherits the base task representation
directly.

Storage contains comments that restate straightforward statements and
duplicate the record schema expressed by named constants. This extra
narration obscures the comments that carry useful context.

Remove the redundant comments so documentation remains focused on
behavior and rationale.

Deadline and Event duplicate the same array-bound, null, and blank
checks for constructor fields. Maintaining parallel validation risks
inconsistent handling as task types evolve.

Move the shared rule into Task and parameterize the task and field names
so each subtype retains a precise error message without repeating the
logic.

Deadline and Event remove optional prefixes using numeric offsets that
duplicate each prefix length. A prefix change can make detection and
extraction disagree.

Name the prefixes and derive their offsets so each parsing rule has a
single source of truth.
Add Java assert feature
Merge branch-A-CodeQuality. Introduce good coding practices to improve readability and reduce complexity and redundancy in code.

Task loading has duplicated parsing and an incomplete try block, so
the project cannot compile.

Remove the duplicate and retain the existing parser so valid tasks
load while damaged records are skipped.

Task lists can only be viewed in insertion order.

Add alphabetical, reverse alphabetical, and task-type sorting.

Preserve relative order within each type.

Document the commands and cover their behavior with tests.

Task lists need flexible ordering as they grow.

Add alphabetical, reverse, and task-type sorting.

Include tests and documentation.
